cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallTypeTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Type tray - allows only continuous walls
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallTypeTray --thickness 6 --burn 0.05 --sx '60*2' --sy '40*3' --h 80 --hi 50 --outside 0 --bottom_edge F --back_height 40 --radius 20 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallTypeTray --thickness --burn --sx --sy --h --hi --outside --bottom_edge --back_height --radius --reference --labels
